# Venn Helix-01 hub set

> Disc brake thru-axle bicycle hub set by Venn Cycling: a 72-tooth helical ratchet that tightens like a bolt as you pedal (no free play under power), a 41.5 mm nano-coated angular contact bearing made for the side loads a bicycle hub carries, a cold-forged shell, a 15 mm 7075-T6 axle. Front 105 g, rear 243 g. Made in Taiwan. USD 449 a set; also built into the Venn 520 HE1 (road), 440 HE1 (gravel) and 5028 HE1 (road and gravel) carbon wheelsets, USD 1,499.

## For wheel builders
For wheel builders (24h straight pull, mm). Front 12x100, OLD 100: disc side spoke circle 44.5, centre to flange 22.2, spoke offset 1.9; open side 35.2, 31.2, 2.0. Rear 12x142, OLD 142: disc side 40.5, 32.7, 2.3; drive side 57.5, 17.2, 2.5. Spoke holes 2.6 mm, head seat 4.2 mm. Offsets measured at the spoke-head seat. Lacing: 2-cross.
